title: Thailand Rejects Cambodia's Claims Made at Francophonie and ASEAN-Related Meetings
detail: Late on November 16, Thailand's Foreign Ministry rejected claims Cambodia raised at the Francophonie meetings in Phnom Penh (Nov 14-16) and at ASEAN-related summits in Manila, including allegations that Thailand occupies Cambodian territory and keeps about 20,000 Cambodians from returning home. Bangkok said the Cambodian chair allowed only a written Thai response, accused Phnom Penh of breaching confidence-building understandings from October 2026 and the May Cebu leaders' meeting, and urged bilateral rather than multilateral resolution. Thai officials separately reaffirmed commitment to the ceasefire accord (reported Nov 15). No new armed clashes were reported.

media.caption: Thailand rejects Cambodia's claims at Francophonie and ASEAN
